audience: email marketers who manage subscribers, broadcasts and automations in Drip

useCases.title: Review a broadcast and its results
useCases.text: List the broadcasts, filtered by status such as sent, and open one. Read the sent, open, click and unsubscribe metrics for a date range.

useCases.title: Check which workflows are active
useCases.text: List the automation workflows filtered by status, and open one to read its details. List the email series campaigns too.

useCases.title: Find subscribers by tag
useCases.text: List the tags, then list subscribers filtered by tag or subscribe date. Open one subscriber to read its tags, custom fields and lead score.

useCases.title: Tag a subscriber and record an event
useCases.text: Create or update a subscriber by email, then apply a tag. A recorded event can start workflows and emails in Drip.
